name: Sompo Holdings, Inc.
summary: Sompo Holdings, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides property and casualty (P&C) insurance products and services in Japan and internationally. It operates through Domestic P&C Insurance Business, Overseas Insurance Business, Domestic Life Insurance Business, Nursing Care Business, and Other segments. The company offers small-amount and short-term insurance products.
